overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structural MRI metadata without DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, SWI/GRE, or histopathology. The T2-FLAIR mismatch and absent enhancement/necrosis strongly favor an IDH-mutant, non-codeleted astrocytoma, but the very large FLAIR volume, mass effect, deep white matter invasion, and ependymal involvement raise concern for biologically extensive disease despite a lower-grade imaging phenotype. Molecular testing remains required for definitive WHO CNS5 classification and grading.
